_comment.description: comment regarding the HPM to which the input applies

Updater.description: Individual who prepared this input file

Files.description: Maximum temperature at which the component operates

Filename.description: Path to a file to be included in the FRU. File index will match the one-based index of this item in the Files array. The path may be relative or absolute.

FormatIdentifier.description: UUID identifying the format for the file.

FormatVersion.description: Version of the format, in PLDM ver32 format.

Resident.description: Indicates whether the file is included in the FRU binary. Default if omitted is true

Dynamic.description: Indicates whether the file is subject to fynamic modification. Default if omitted is false

ChecksumPresent.description: Indicates whether a CRC-32 integrity checksum for the file is included in the FRU binary. Default if omitted is true

Compression.description: Indicates compression to be applied to the file.

CustomCompressionUUID.description: UUID for custom compression to be applied to the file.

CustomCompressionCommandLine.description: Shell command to apply custom compression to the file. Input file (mandatory) is represented by %1 in the command line; output file (optional) is represented by %2 in the command line.

CustomCompressionOutputFilename.description: Filename that applies when custom compression has been applied to the file. If omitted. defaults to %2 from `CustomCompressionOutputFilename (if %2 was supplied) or to the input file (if %2 was not supplied).

Context.description: Numeric value to supply for the Context field in the files table. Defaults to 0 if omitted.
